local.description: Node-local ordinal, allocated by the owning registry.

node.description: Owning node; `0`, the local node, throughout v4.0 (X7).

NodeId.description:
A node in the (future) multi-host deployment. `0` (the local node) is the only legal value in v4.0.

Rule: X7 (`00-overview.md`); it qualifies every id of TM-11, SC-6, SB-3 and MA-38.

TimePoint.description:
An instant: integer ticks in a named clock domain. Never floating-point seconds.

There is deliberately no `PartialOrd`: two points of different domains cannot be
compared at all, and `a < b` silently answering `false` is the bug class this
model exists to prevent (decision T3).

Rule: TM-1, TM-6.

ticks.description: Tick count relative to the domain's origin; a sample index in a SampleClock (TM-10).

TxUnderflowCause.description: Why a transmit stream underflowed (RM-11, VE-3).

oneOf.description: The device ran out of samples inside a burst because the host was late.
Samples of a burst were lost between host and device.

resumes_at.description: The instant a repeat resumes at, where the Provider paused it (RM-11, UR-22): nothing is transmitted before it from the event's instant. Absent when the repeat ended and for a burst that is not a repeat.
